['B. Braun Melsungen AG '].company_description: B. Braun is a German medical and pharmaceutical device company with more than 63,000 employees globally. It has offices and production facilities in over 60 countries and offers more than 5,000 different healthcare products, 95% of which are manufactured by the company. In 2018, the company had a revenue of 6.908 billion Euros.

['TK Elevator GmbH '].company_description: TK Elevator GmbH operates in the elevator industry, serving customers in over 100 countries with a network of about 1,000 locations. The company offers the EOX Renew, an ultra-flexible elevator that enhances accessibility, sustainability, and property value in older buildings. Additionally, TK Elevator provides products such as escalators, software, and passenger boarding bridges.
